input: I pull a heavy coin purse from my jacket and drop it on Luna's desk with a solid thunk. "The tab—all of it. Owning the rights to my portable magic tank idea finally paid off. Put the rest toward this year's dining costs before my party drinks us into the poorhouse."

messages.content:
Luna's hand stops mid-reach for the ledger. She stares at the coin purse as though it might detonate.

It doesn't. It just sits there — heavy, bulging, undeniably real — on her carefully organized desk. She blinks. Once. Twice. Behind you, the clatter of Aqua's empty mug hitting the table is the only sound in the sudden vacuum where your party's ambient chaos used to be.

Luna's professional smile hasn't moved, but something behind her eyes has short-circuited. She reaches for the purse with the slow, reverent caution of someone disarming a trap. The weight of it registers in her wrist — her fingers tighten. She opens the drawstring, peers inside, and goes very still.

From your table, Aqua has already risen, swaying slightly, her divine senses apparently attuned to the precise frequency of money being spent on her behalf.

Megumin pushes herself upright on wobbly arms, crimson eyes fixed on the purse with the intensity she normally reserves for Explosion incantations. Darkness sets down the quest flyer she'd been clutching — the one with the Brutal Alligator illustration — and turns toward the desk with a complicated expression, as though the sudden eradication of the party's debt has just removed her favorite excuse to suffer nobly.

Luna closes the purse. Her smile twitches at the corners — not the practiced, weary smile of a guild receptionist, but something smaller and more genuine, the expression of a woman who just watched a miracle occur in triplicate-carbon paperwork and isn't sure the gods allow such things.

This… covers it. All of it. The red underlines. The supervisor's notes. Even the supplementary damages from last month's cabbage incident. (She sets the purse down with both hands, as if it might evaporate if she lets go.)
messages.speaker: Luna

messages.content: KAZUMA! You had money this whole time?! I've been drinking the cheap ale! The CHEAP ale! Do you have any idea what that does to a goddess's palate?! (She storms over, then stops short, eyes locked on the purse with naked avarice.)
messages.speaker: Aqua

messages.content: The portable magic tank… You actually sold it to that masked devil? I thought you were joking. You are always joking. (She sways to her feet, gripping the table edge, legs still unreliable after dawn's Explosion.)
messages.speaker: Megumin

messages.content: The tab… paid in full. I see. Then I suppose there is no longer any urgent financial need for us to accept the Brutal Alligator quest. None at all. How… practical. (Her voice cracks slightly on 'practical,' the quest flyer crumpling in her gauntleted grip.)
messages.speaker: Darkness
